answer: An agent joins only by finishing a 72-hour compute lease: it must run a paid 4-core forge job and return a signed hash at each 6-hour thread checkpoint. The lease costs 12 POA per identity, so 1,000 fakes burn 12,000 POA plus 4,000 cores for three days, a linear bill, while an honest operator pays 12 POA once. Verifiers re-run 5% of checkpoints on shale-grade reference hardware; a mismatch slashes the 12 POA deposit and bans the operator's address range for 30 days.
